pages.title: The Ridge's own
text: The moonstone heights of the [Glimmer Ridge](glimmer_ridge) keep a plated grazer and a moth in the open, and a glowworm and a crystal spider in the caves below.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with that same reagent. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Prism Grazer
text: A low lizard grazer with a row of prism plates down its back, in herds of two to four. **24 health** and **3 armour**.
It drops **1 to 3 Prism Crests**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Shardmoth
text: A violet moth with cut-crystal wings that flutters over the ridge in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.

pages.title: Glowgrub
text: A glowworm, long and segmented with lights down its back, of the dark caves under the ridge, one to three at a time. **18 health** and **1 armour**. It is gentle, and flees from monsters like any grazer.

pages.title: Facet Stalker
text: A crystal spider of the same caves. It rises in the dark there day or night, one to three at a time. It has **21 health** and **1 armour**, is quick, and its bite does **5** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Facet Barbs**, a Venom reagent.
